[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]close sase-zr.[/#D7D7AF]

[dim]  1 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Conflict rejection while running, durable failure outcomes, [/bold #D7AFFF]  [bold white on #D75F87] large  [/bold white on #D75F87]
      [bold #D7AFFF]truthful attempt completion[/bold #D7AFFF]
    [#AF87FF]decision-integrity[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]decision-integrity: in sase-core and sase, record a verifiable execution[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]owner on every accepted receipt, reject conflicting answers while the [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]owner is live, permit supersede and cancel only after a durable failed [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]outcome or a proven-dead owner, record a redacted durable failure [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]outcome for command, archive, side-effect and post-acceptance GateError [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]failures, journal attempt_completed only after terminal preparation [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]succeeds, give poll_gate and waiting requesters a failure result, and [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]publish one deduped failure notification with resume, restart and cancel[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]actions.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  2 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Receipt-derived approval labels and honest commit status[/bold #D7AFFF]      [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]approval-projection[dim] · [dim][/dim]after decision-integrity[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]approval-projection: derive TALE/EPIC APPROVED from the acceptance [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]receipt on every load path, show PLAN COMMITTED only after archive [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]success and roll it back on failure, surface the failed outcome as a [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]distinct status, and publish response.json, shell terminal state and the[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]refresh pulse before post-terminal epic launch preparation.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  3 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Exact, off-loop ACE refresh and actionable failure recovery[/bold #D7AFFF]   [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]ace-fast-refresh[dim] · [dim][/dim]after decision-integrity, approval-projection[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]ace-fast-refresh: route gate receipts and watcher observations to exact [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]shell, planner and family row deltas, fix the notification-cache [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]disappearance race, make the acceptance pulse target the exact agent [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]directory, move the remaining synchronous count refresh and journal [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]reads off the UI thread and message pump, and add the plan-gate [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]partial_attempt retry path plus failure-notification [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]resume/restart/cancel actions.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  4 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Authenticated Telegram updates and TTY-only pre-rejection[/bold #D7AFFF]     [bold black on #87D7FF] small  [/bold black on #87D7FF]

    [#D7D7AF]fixture, run every changed repo's checks plus sase's combined check-full[/#D7D7AF]

    [#D7D7AF]narrowed-contract re-verification of parent sase-zr to the land agent.[/#D7D7AF]
